description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe and Todd Webb sitting together on the wellhead at the Abiquiu house squinting in the sun; O'Keeffe is dressed in a black suite a black shoes with her hair in a bun and her hands folded in her lap; Webb is dressed in a beige jacket and slacks holding a cap on his lap and wearing work boots; adobe wall and door in background.
title: Georgia and Todd Sitting on Bench Outside
